result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now runs the same code as `updateLandscape`, with the same options. It compiles (`mvn -o -pl cli test-compile`), but I didn't run any tests or run the command itself.

- **`Commands.java`:**
  - Added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description. The description says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`.
  - Added `analyzeLandscape` to the no-argument usage overview, using the same options as `updateLandscape`.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`:**
  - Both command names now go to the existing `updateLandscape(args)` method.
  - `-help` prints the usage for whichever name was typed, so `analyzeLandscape -help` shows `java -jar sokrates.jar analyzeLandscape` and the new description. `updateLandscape -help` is unchanged.
- **`README.md`:** The README had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Landscape command" section. It documents `analyzeLandscape -analysisRoot <folder>`, notes that `updateLandscape` still works as the old name, and points to `-help`.

I haven't committed anything.
